subject: uneven number of days per season

messages.author: 99f110fd6fce388c
messages.subject: uneven number of days per season
parts:
Hi,

I'm working on a multi-season model using colext. I have three seasons with 122 days of camera trap data, and a final season with 76. Currently the data going into my camera operation matrix has a single row for every camera, with down time listed as "problems." As such, I did not use the "sessionCol" to create my operation matrix. 

Now, when I made a UMF to go into colext, its summary says there are 4 primary survey periods (correct) and 110 secondary survey periods (incorrect, I believe). Is the best way to solve this re-formatting my input data so I make use of the sessionCol? 

I posted this to the unmarked group as well and was pointed this direction, so I hope this is the right place! Please let me know if I need to clarify/share any other info to make my question make sense.

Thanks!
Katie

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: uneven number of days per season
parts:
Hi Katie, 
the main problem with treating multiple seasons as one season (one row per camera and using the problem columns) is the closure assumption, which will most likely not hold over extended time frames. 
So yes, I believe using the session column would be the best way forward. In your case it would mean separating the multiple deployments into separate rows and creating a session column to keep them apart.

camtrapR contains sample data and sample code for multi-season analyses which you can use as guidance. Please see the vignette for some more explanations and examples for multi-season occupancy models: 
https://jniedballa.github.io/camtrapR/articles/camtrapr3.html#multi-season-occupancy-analyses

?camtrapsMultiSeason
?recordTableSampleMultiSeason

The examples of detectionHistory() show how to use them to create unmarkedFrames.
Best,
Jürgen
